translationRepairs: Qing Gui, whose courtesy name was Shuzhai, belonged to the Zhangjia clan, came from the Manchu Bordered Yellow Banner, and was the son of Grand Secretary Yin Jishan.
Qinggui, whose courtesy name was Shuzhai, belonged to the Zhangjia clan, came from the Manchu Bordered Yellow Banner, and was the son of Grand Secretary Yin Jishan.
慶桂 is the single Manchu name Qinggui.

At that time Shaanxi-Gansu Governor-General Fuk'anggan had gone to Aksu to pacify returning populations; because Qing Gui was experienced in frontier affairs, the emperor ordered him to carry the imperial commissioner seal, hurry to Gansu, and serve temporarily as governor-general.

At that time Shaanxi-Gansu Governor-General Fuk'anggan had gone to Aksu to pacify the Muslim population; because Qing Gui was experienced in frontier affairs, the emperor ordered him to carry the imperial commissioner seal, hurry to Gansu, and serve temporarily as governor-general.
回眾 are Muslims, not returning people.
In Qianlong 25 (1760) he passed the metropolitan examination, entered the Hanlin Academy as a bachelor, was appointed compiler, and rose in succession to reader in the Directorate of Astronomy.

In Qianlong 25 (1760) he passed the metropolitan examination, entered the Hanlin Academy as a bachelor, was appointed compiler, and rose in succession to librarian of the Household Administration of the Heir Apparent.
司經局洗馬 is a post in the heir apparent's library, not astronomy.
Having held power for a long time, the Jiaqing Emperor entrusted him with complete confidence.
After he had held power for a long time, the Jiaqing Emperor entrusted him with complete confidence.
Quheng, not the emperor, is the one who held power.
Censor Hua Jie memorialized on arrears in the Changlu salt tax; Quheng was then managing the Ministry of Revenue, and the matter was referred to the salt administration for investigation.

Supervising Secretary Hua Jie memorialized on arrears in the Changlu salt tax; Quheng was then managing the Ministry of Revenue, and the matter was referred to the salt administration for investigation.
給事中 is a supervising secretary, not a censor.

At that time Governor-General Bailing was impeached for demanding supplies and inventing illegal punishments in Guangdong; Tuo Jin was ordered with Governor Hutuoli to try the case and requested Bailing's dismissal.

At that time Governor-General Bailing was impeached for demanding supplies and inventing illegal punishments in Guangdong; Tuo Jin was ordered with Governor-General Hutuli to try the case and requested Bailing's dismissal.
瑚圖禮 is Hutuli, and 總督 is governor-general.

In Jiaqing 11 (1806) he was transferred to the Ministry of Revenue; together with Vice Minister Guangxing he investigated Eastern Rivers Governor-General Li Hente for forcibly assigning bureau staff, stripped Hente of office, and sent him into exile.

In Jiaqing 11 (1806) he was transferred to the Ministry of Revenue; together with Vice Minister Guangxing he investigated Eastern Rivers Governor-General Li Hengte for forcibly assigning bureau staff, stripped Hengte of office, and sent him into exile.
In Jinxian, Shandong, thieves gathered a crowd to resist arrest; Governor Tongxing reported them as remnant sect followers.
In Jinxiang, Shandong, thieves gathered a crowd to resist arrest; Governor Tongxing reported them as remnant sect followers.
Investigation now showed an actual deficit before year 14 of more than 3,410,000 taels, and 14 years later a further deficit of more than 3,340,000 taels.
Investigation now showed an actual deficit before year 14 of more than 3,410,000 taels, and after year 14 a further deficit of more than 3,340,000 taels.
十四年以後 means after Jiaqing 14.
Prefect Yuan Jie had made a false report and was stripped of office.
Department Magistrate Yuan Jie had made a false report and was stripped of office.
知州 is a department magistrate.
His father Qian was a Han Chinese circuit intendant of Huangde.

漢黃德道 is the Han-Huang-De circuit, not Han Chinese.
Yinpu was only nine; in poverty he followed his mother to rely on his father-in-law and studied at Changshan.
Yinpu was only nine; in poverty he followed his mother to rely on her father and studied at Changshan.
婦翁 here is the mother's father.
